ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Optimize your ecommerce store's checkout process to minimize cart abandonment and increase revenue.

ONBOARDING
1. Start by setting up your account.
2. Connect your ecommerce store to our platform.
3. Review your current checkout flow and identify areas for improvement.

EMPTY STATE
1. No abandoned carts data available yet. Add some test orders to get started!
2. Your checkout optimization settings are not configured. Set them up now!
3. You haven't connected any ecommerce stores yet. Start by adding one!

ERROR
1. Unable to connect your ecommerce store. Check your API credentials and try again.
2. Your checkout flow is incomplete. Finish setting it up before proceeding.
3. Abandoned cart data not available. Ensure you have at least 30 days of data.

TOAST
1. Checkout optimization settings saved!
2. Ecommerce store connected successfully!
3. Results ready for analysis!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Save Profile
2. Start Setup
3. Review Result
4. Edit Account
5. Run Analysis
6. Optimize Flow
7. Connect Store
8. View Output
